contract_proposal.statement: Row-index grouping assigns first-observed group identities, covers every row exactly once with ordered memberships and first representatives, and returns caller-owned metadata arrays with validated key and index errors.

case.evidence: Independent pure KeyCell expected_key_ids quadratic equality model plus exact11-row NaN/zero/null literal IDs+representatives. Float64/Float32/String/Int64/single/composite keys; lengths0/1/11 and three layouts. Every API (count,height,ids,group_of,representative,representatives,rows,all_rows,sizes); independent payload associations through caller take; mutate returned metadata without corrupting source; exact no-key/duplicate/unknown and row/group bounds errors.

source_review.body_review: All eight tests/helpers read; replaces old cross-production group-count comparison with complete independently modeled grouping, preserves caller subframe use and ownership guarantees.
